inputFields.name: absolutePath
inputFields.description: Controls whether to render media links as absolute.

inputFields.name: allowStretch
inputFields.description: Controls whether to allow image stretch.

inputFields.name: alwaysAppendRevision
inputFields.description: Controls whether to include the media item revision.

inputFields.name: alwaysIncludeServerUrl
inputFields.description: Controls whether to include the server address (host).

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: Sets the database.

inputFields.name: disableMediaCache
inputFields.description: Controls whether to disable using media cache.

inputFields.name: height
inputFields.description: Sets height for images.

inputFields.name: ignoreAspectRatio
inputFields.description: Controls whether to respect the aspect ratio when resizing.

inputFields.name: includeExtension
inputFields.description: Controls whether to include the media extension.

inputFields.name: language
inputFields.description: Sets media language.

inputFields.name: lowercaseUrls
inputFields.description: Controls the letter case for the generated URL.

inputFields.name: maxHeight
inputFields.description: Sets max height for images.

inputFields.name: maxWidth
inputFields.description: Sets max width for images.

inputFields.name: mediaLinkServerUrl
inputFields.description: Sets Server url that will be used for media links. Used only when AlwaysIncludeServerUrl is set to true.

inputFields.name: requestExtension
inputFields.description: Sets media extension.

inputFields.name: scale
inputFields.description: Sets scale for images.

inputFields.name: thumbnail
inputFields.description: Controls whether to generate a thumbnail.

inputFields.name: useItemPath
inputFields.description: Controls whether to include item path.

inputFields.name: version
inputFields.description: Sets media version.

inputFields.name: width
inputFields.description: Sets width for images.
